heading: Work
subtext: Projects we have built across mobile apps, AI tools, automation and business software.

items.title: JadooTech Enterprises Website
items.problem: Needed a zero-cost lead-capture site that works without a backend.
items.solution: Static HTML/CSS/JS site on GitHub Pages with Google Apps Script handling form submissions to a private Google Sheet.
items.result: Live at jadootechenterprises.github.io. Enquiries land directly in Google Sheets as structured rows.

items.title: Do.er — Personal Mobile Assistant
items.problem: Managing tasks, phone controls and getting quick answers required switching between multiple apps with no single intelligent layer.
items.solution: A personal mobile assistant app that understands natural language, controls phone functions, answers questions contextually and adapts to the user mood and working style.
items.result: One unified assistant for task management, phone control and intelligent Q&A built around how the user actually works.

terminalLines.text: User: Set DND and remind me at 5pm

items.title: Simple Chatbot
items.problem: Businesses needed a lightweight customisable chatbot for their website without complex infrastructure.
items.solution: A clean embeddable chatbot with a Python LLM API backend. Configurable persona, custom FAQs and a simple web interface that drops into any site.
items.result: Deployed as a widget on client sites. Handles common queries instantly, reducing manual response time.

terminalLines.text: User: What are your working hours?
Bot: Yes, 0% EMI on orders above 5000.

items.title: AI Data Analyst Tool
items.problem: Business owners had data in Excel and PDFs but no easy way to get answers, trends or charts without hiring a data analyst.
items.solution: Upload any Excel or PDF file or add your company API key. The tool analyses the data, answers questions in plain English and generates charts and bar graphs automatically.
items.result: Non-technical users can interrogate their own business data and get visual reports in seconds with no code required.

terminalLines.text: Query: Which product had highest growth?
Answer: Product B, 34% growth in Q3

items.title: Smart Attendance System
items.problem: Manual attendance registers were slow and error-prone, requiring someone to compile reports every month from paper sheets.
items.solution: A web-based attendance system with face recognition or QR code check-in, automatic daily logs, monthly Excel reports and an admin dashboard.
items.result: Attendance marking time reduced from 5 minutes to under 30 seconds per session. Reports generated automatically at month-end.

items.title: Developer Portfolio Website
items.problem: Developers and freelancers needed a clean fast personal portfolio that showcases their work without paying for hosting.
items.solution: A responsive portfolio website built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, deployed free on GitHub Pages with project showcase, skills section and contact form.
items.result: Zero-cost professional online presence deployed in under a day. Fully customisable and easy to update.

items.title: Expenses Management System
items.problem: Small business owners tracked expenses in notebooks with no visibility into spending categories, monthly totals or budget limits.
items.solution: A web application where users log expenses by category, set monthly budgets, view spending breakdowns as charts and export reports to Excel or PDF.
items.result: Clear monthly spending visibility with automatic budget alerts. Users identified and reduced 20 to 30 percent of unnecessary recurring expenses.

items.title: Restaurant Billing Software
items.problem: A restaurant managed orders and bills on paper, leading to errors, slow service and no data on daily sales or popular items.
items.solution: A web-based billing system with table management, menu builder, order taking, bill generation with GST and an end-of-day sales report.
items.result: Order processing time cut by 40 percent. Daily sales reports generated automatically. Zero billing errors since deployment.

items.title: Daily Report Automation
items.problem: Team spent 3 hours each morning copying order data from emails into Excel then emailing a summary to managers.
items.solution: Python script runs at 8 am via Windows Task Scheduler. Reads inbox, extracts structured data, updates the master workbook and emails the formatted report.
items.result: 3-hour daily task reduced to 0 manual minutes. Script has run reliably for 90 plus days.

items.title: E-commerce API Integration
items.problem: Every Shopify order required manual steps: update ERP stock, send WhatsApp notification, log to Google Sheet.
items.solution: Python webhook listener on VPS. On each new order it pushes to ERP via REST, fires WhatsApp Business API message and appends row to Google Sheet.
items.result: 3 manual steps per order eliminated. Integration handles 200 plus orders per day without intervention.
